coreMemory.english: v. to direct your eyes toward someone or something；v. to appear or seem in a particular way；v. to search for, examine, or consider something
coreMemory.structure: look at something /ˈlʊk ˈæt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（看某物）；look for something /ˈlʊk ˈfɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（寻找某物）；look like something /ˈlʊk ˈlaɪk ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（看起来像某物）；look forward to doing something /ˈlʊk ˈfɔːrwɚd ˈtuː ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（期待做某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ look forward to to do something → ✅ look forward to doing something；❌ look something → ✅ look at something

commonErrors.wrong: look forward to to do something
commonErrors.note: “look forward to doing something”是需要动词 -ing 形式的固定结构；doing 是占位符，应换成具体动词的 -ing 形式。
在“look at something”这个常用搭配中，介词 at 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

synonyms.difference: watch 侧重“观看；注视”。对应的常用英文义是 “to direct the eyes, appear, or search for something”。look 在本卡搭配“look at something”中表达“看”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“看”这个义项下，ignore（忽视；不看）与 look 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of look”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: 口语中也可指外表好看的人。

confusables.difference: see 表示“看见；查看；参观”；look 在本卡核心搭配“look at something”中表示“看”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
